## Main Studies

### Participants

```{r main_participants_setup, include=FALSE}
library("here")
library("tidyverse")
library("rlang")
library("gt")

data_path <- here("_data", "_participant_scores", "wave_2")

# read in data
wave_2_dfs <- readRDS(here(data_path, "wave_2_dfs.RDS"))

# subset each df
wave_2_demog_dfs <- lapply(wave_2_dfs, function(df){
  df <- df |> select(participant_ID, Age, Sex, `Ethnicity`) |> unique()})

# bring back spectrum
for (name in c("speeches1", "speeches2")) {
  wave_2_demog_dfs[[name]] <- merge(
    wave_2_demog_dfs[[name]],
    wave_2_dfs[[name]] |> 
      dplyr::select(participant_ID, `Political spectrum (us)`) |> unique(),
    by = "participant_ID")}

rm(wave_2_dfs)

# convert age to numeric
wave_2_demog_dfs <- lapply(wave_2_demog_dfs, function(df){df|>mutate(Age = as.numeric(Age))})

# recode Asian ethnicity
wave_2_demog_dfs <- lapply(wave_2_demog_dfs, function(df){
  df |> mutate(Ethnicity = case_when(
    Ethnicity == "East Asian" | Ethnicity == "South East Asian" | Ethnicity == "South Asian" ~ "Asian", 
    .default = Ethnicity))})

wave_labels <- c(
  lyrics1   = "Main 1 (Lyrics 1)",
  lyrics2   = "Main 2 (Lyrics 2)",
  speeches1 = "Main 3 (Speeches 1)",
  speeches2 = "Main 4 (Speeches 2)"
)
```

```{r main_participants_table_functions, include=FALSE}
format_apa_table <- function(gt_tbl, title, subtitle = NULL) {
  gt_tbl %>%
    tab_header(
      title = title, 
      subtitle = subtitle
    ) %>%
    tab_options(
      table.font.names                  = c("Times New Roman", "Times", "serif"),
      table.border.top.width            = 1,  # top line
      column_labels.border.bottom.width = 1,  # header line
      table.border.bottom.width         = 1,  # bottom line
      table_body.hlines.width           = 0,  # no row lines
      data_row.padding                  = px(2)
    )
}

summarize_demographics <- function(df, study_name) {
  df %>%
    summarise(
      Study   = study_name,
      N       = n(),
      Age_M   = mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
      Age_SD  = sd(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
      Age_Min  = min(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
      Age_Max  = max(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
      Female_p  = mean(Sex == "Female", na.rm = TRUE) * 100) %>%
  mutate(
    `Age M (SD)` = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", Age_M, Age_SD),
    `Age range`  = sprintf("%d–%d", round(Age_Min), round(Age_Max)),
    `% Female`   = round(Female_p, 1)) %>%
  select(Study, N, `Age M (SD)`, `Age range`, `% Female`)
}

summarize_ethnicity <- function(df, study_name) {
  df %>%
    count(Ethnicity) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = 100 * n / sum(n),
      value = paste0(n, " (", round(pct, 1), "%)")
    ) %>%
    select(Ethnicity, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Ethnicity, values_from = value) %>%
    mutate(Study = study_name, .before = 1)
}


summarize_spectrum <- function(df, study_name) {
  df %>%
    count(`Political spectrum (us)`) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = 100 * n / sum(n),
      value = paste0(n, " (", round(pct, 1), "%)")
    ) %>%
    select(`Political spectrum (us)`, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = `Political spectrum (us)`, values_from = value) %>%
    mutate(Study = study_name, .before = 1)
}
```

```{r}
# demographics table

wave_demog_tbl <- imap_dfr(
  wave_2_demog_dfs,
  ~ summarize_demographics(.x, wave_labels[[.y]] %||% .y)
)

# main table
wave_demog_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_align(align = "left",  columns = c(Study)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(N, `% Female`, `Age range`, `Age M (SD)`)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = `% Female`, decimals = 1) %>%
  format_apa_table("Table 1b", "Participant demographics — Main studies")
```

```{r}
wave_ethnicity_tbl <- imap_dfr(
  wave_2_demog_dfs,
  ~ summarize_ethnicity(.x, wave_labels[[.y]] %||% .y))

wave_ethnicity_tbl |>
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    `Black/African American` = html("Black/<br>African American"),
    `Latino/Hispanic`        = html("Latino/<br>Hispanic"),
    Asian                    = "Asian",
    White                    = "White") |>
  
  fmt_number(columns = -Study, decimals = 1) %>%
  
  cols_align(align = "center", 
             columns = c(Asian, `Black/African American`, 
                         `Latino/Hispanic`, White)) %>%
  
  format_apa_table("Table 2c", "Participant ethnicity — Main studies")
```

```{r}
wave_spectrum_tbl <- imap_dfr(
  wave_2_demog_dfs[3:4],
  ~ summarize_spectrum(.x, wave_labels[[.y]] %||% .y))

wave_spectrum_tbl |>
  
  gt() %>%
  
  fmt_number(
    columns = -Study, 
    decimals = 1
  ) %>%
  
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(Conservative, Liberal, Moderate)) %>%
  
  format_apa_table("Table 5", "Participants by political leaning — Main studies")
```
